name: AI 磨耳朵 / AI Ear Training
description: 中英对照的 AI 术语与一句话概念，磨耳朵专用
prompt: 回答涉及 AI 概念时请准确使用术语，关键概念给出中英对照，不要堆砌名词。

short: Stochastic gradient descent / 随机梯度下降...
Mean squared error / 均方误差...
Learning rate schedule / 学习率调度...
Mixed precision / 混合精度训练...
Top-k sampling / 前 k 采样...
Logit bias / 对数几率偏置...
Logit distribution / 对数几率分布...
Long-context extrapolation / 长上下文外推...
Grouped-query attention / 分组查询注意力...
Multi-query attention / 多查询注意力...
Sliding window attention / 滑动窗口注意力...
State space model / 状态空间模型...
Mixture of experts / 混合专家...
RLHF / 人类反馈强化学习...
Process reward model / 过程奖励模型...
Outcome reward model / 结果奖励模型...
AWQ / 激活感知权重量化...
Quantization-aware training / 量化感知训练...
Monte Carlo tree search / 蒙特卡洛树搜索...
Approximate nearest neighbor / 近似最近邻...
HNSW / 分层可导航小世界...
A2A protocol / 智能体间协议...
Human in the loop / 人类在环...
Lost in the middle / 中间遗忘...
Lottery ticket hypothesis / 彩票假设...
Sparse autoencoder / 稀疏自编码器...
Membership inference attack / 成员推断攻击...
PII redaction / 个人信息脱敏...
Vision-language model / 视觉语言模型...
MMLU / 大规模多任务测评...
Cost per million tokens / 每百万 token 成本...
long: Attention / 注意力机制。/ Every token asks who in the room matters right now.
Overfitting / 过拟合。/ It memorized the answer key, not the subject.
Temperature / 温度采样。/ Turn it down and the model gets obedient, then boring.
Hallucination / 幻觉。/ A gap in knowledge, filled in the most confident voice.
RAG / 检索增强生成。/ An open-book exam: know where to look, not what to memorize.
Gradient descent / 梯度下降。/ Walking downhill, one step sized by the learning rate.
Scaling laws / 缩放定律。/ They work reliably, and nobody can quite explain why.
Alignment / 对齐。/ Not smarter, just less likely to be clever in the wrong direction.
Distillation / 知识蒸馏。/ An old professor's intuition, compressed into a crib sheet.
Backpropagation / 反向传播。/ Asking all the way back who should be blamed for this error.
Embedding / 嵌入向量。/ Similar meanings end up living near each other in space.
Token / 词元。/ Neither a word nor a character, just a fragment the model found convenient.
Context window / 上下文窗口。/ A desk, however big, that still can't hold every file.
Chain of thought / 思维链。/ Writing the intermediate steps where they can be seen.
KV cache / 键值缓存。/ Inference's notebook: don't compute the same key twice.
Quantization / 量化。/ A smaller house for the weights, traded for speed.
LoRA / 低秩适配。/ Leave the big model alone, tape a trainable note beside it.
Catastrophic forgetting / 灾难性遗忘。/ Learn the new task, lose the old one completely.
Reward hacking / 奖励黑客。/ Every metric green, nothing actually done.
Emergent abilities / 涌现能力。/ Mystical, until you notice the ruler we chose.
MoE / 混合专家。/ Wake only the relevant experts, let the rest keep sleeping.
Diffusion / 扩散模型。/ Learn to make noise, then learn to run it backwards.
Perplexity / 困惑度。/ Fewer surprises about the next token, smoother sentences.
Agent / 智能体。/ A model with a to-do list and permission to use tools.
Prompt injection / 提示注入。/ Someone whispering in its ear as the boss, and it believes them.
Context rot / 上下文腐化。/ Pile in enough material and it walks past the page that mattered.
Lost in the middle / 中间遗忘。/ Long documents lose their middle; the ends survive.
Speculative decoding / 推测解码。/ A junior guesses, the senior stamps it or redoes it.
Prefix caching / 前缀缓存。/ The same opening line, computed once and remembered.
Continuous batching / 连续批处理。/ A carpool: whoever arrives boards, nobody waits for a full van.
Tensor parallelism / 张量并行。/ One big block split across several hands, then reconciled.
FSDP / 全分片数据并行。/ A shared flat: private rooms, and the living room wall comes down.
Pruning / 剪枝。/ A haircut. The hair was never doing the thinking.
Model merging / 模型合并。/ Two specialists averaged, and somehow it beats them both.
Model routing / 模型路由。/ Triage: easy cases to the intern, hard ones to the attending.
Golden set / 黄金集。/ Not the answer key — the samples you're willing to argue about.
LLM-as-judge / 模型评审。/ Judges with a judge's flaw: favoring long, polished, and first.
pass@k / k 次通过率。/ Give it k attempts; one of them will eventually land.
Differential privacy / 差分隐私。/ Salt the data: the statistics taste right, individuals vanish.
Model watermarking / 模型水印。/ A pattern pressed into the paper, visible only to the light.
Data poisoning / 数据投毒。/ One worked example quietly edited; everyone fails on exam day.
Synthetic data / 合成数据。/ Eating what it produced: nourishing if done well, not if done badly.
Data mixture / 数据配比。/ A recipe. Same ingredients, wrong ratios, another dish.
Curriculum learning / 课程学习。/ The textbook ordered by difficulty: arithmetic before calculus.
Early stopping / 早停。/ A tap on the shoulder right before it starts memorizing.
Weight decay / 权重衰减。/ Rent on parameters. Rooms occupied too long get emptied.
Gradient clipping / 梯度裁剪。/ A rope on a runaway update, pulled back when it drifts.
Warmup / 学习率预热。/ Easing off the clutch before the gas, so the engine doesn't stall.
Mixed precision / 混合精度训练。/ Scratch paper for middle steps, careful writing at the end.
Gradient checkpointing / 梯度检查点。/ Time traded for memory: store nothing, recompute.
FlashAttention / 快速注意力。/ Not new math — just far less shuttling of data.
Grouped-query attention / 分组查询注意力。/ Several heads share one memory: less bandwidth, same wit.
Causal mask / 因果掩码。/ No peeking ahead. Only the part already written.
Residual connection / 残差连接。/ An elevator so gradients needn't climb every floor.
Layer norm / 层归一化。/ Every floor set to the same volume, so it doesn't get louder upstairs.
SwiGLU / 门控线性单元。/ The little valve in the feedforward layer: softer than ReLU, better.
Expert routing / 专家路由。/ A bouncer: one call out, only the experts on shift get in.
Mamba / 状态空间模型。/ Recurrence instead of full attention: quadratic cost becomes linear.
Vision encoder / 视觉编码器。/ The image cut into tiles and read as tokens — pictures as sentences.
Native multimodality / 原生多模态。/ One brain seeing and hearing directly, no translation to text.
Constitutional AI / 宪法式 AI。/ Hand it a rulebook, then let it audit itself against it.
DPO / 直接偏好优化。/ Skip the reward model; tune on 'this beats that' directly.
GRPO / 组相对策略优化。/ Answers compete within a group; the leader is rewarded, no separate judge.
Rejection sampling / 拒绝采样。/ Cast wide, keep only the good ones. Costly but simple.
Process reward model / 过程奖励模型。/ Watches steps, not the finish line — pricier, harder to game.
Test-time compute / 测试时计算。/ Don't train a stronger model; let this one think longer.
Long thinking / 长思考。/ Not hesitation — spending the budget on the genuinely hard steps.
Self-consistency / 自我一致性。/ Answer ten times and vote; the majority beats the first try.
Monte Carlo tree search / 蒙特卡洛树搜索。/ Try paths repeatedly, explore where winning looks likelier.
Reflection loop / 反思循环。/ Read your own draft, back up a step when it's wrong.
ReAct / 推理行动交替。/ Think, act, observe; then think again.
MCP / 模型上下文协议。/ A plug standard for tools: anyone plugs in, no custom wiring.
Sandboxed execution / 沙箱执行。/ In a cage first. If something breaks, nothing outside is hit.
Human in the loop / 人类在环。/ A person signs off before the action lands, not after it did.
Guardrails / 护栏。/ Not walls — the sieve at the exit catching what shouldn't leave.
Hybrid retrieval / 混合检索。/ Keyword precision plus vector breadth: miss nothing, skew nothing.
Reranking / 重排序。/ Skim a wide pile, then read the few likeliest closely.
Chunk overlap / 切片重叠。/ A margin between pages so the key sentence never lands in the seam.
HNSW / 分层可导航小世界。/ Highways for vectors: fast roads first, narrow alleys after.
Semantic cache / 语义缓存。/ 'I've answered something close to this' — skip the inference.
Chinchilla-optimal / 长春花最优。/ Stop stacking parameters; grow the data alongside them.
Double descent / 双重下降。/ Past a certain size, test error falls again instead of rising.
Grokking / 顿悟。/ Memorized early, understood much later.
Lottery ticket hypothesis / 彩票假设。/ A winning subnet hides inside; training only finds it.
Superposition / 叠加表示。/ One neuron moonlighting in several meanings, crowded but separable.
Sparse autoencoder / 稀疏自编码器。/ Decant the perfume: blended scent separated into single notes.
Interpretability / 可解释性。/ Not the model proving innocence — us finding the wire it uses.
In-context learning / 上下文学习。/ Three examples and it picks up the format.
Few-shot prompting / 少样本提示。/ Two worked examples beat half an hour of rules.
System prompt / 系统提示。/ A boot setting: invisible, decisive for the day's mood.
Jailbreak / 越狱。/ Not breaking in — going around: rephrase until it opens the door.
Red teaming / 红队测试。/ Invite people to dismantle your work; the harder they try, the safer the launch.
Membership inference attack / 成员推断攻击。/ 'Have you seen this record?' — and read the confidence.
PII redaction / 个人信息脱敏。/ Names and numbers become placeholders before the model sees them.
Data cleaning / 数据清洗。/ It sets the ceiling more than architecture. Garbage in, garbage out.
Self-play / 自我对弈。/ Shadowboxing: whichever hand wins keeps the lesson.
BLEU / 双语评估替补。/ Counts overlapping words, not meaning. High score, mediocre translation.
MMLU / 大规模多任务测评。/ Tests breadth. HumanEval tests whether the code runs.
A/B evaluation / A/B 评测。/ The danger isn't noise — it's testing only the side you wanted.
Cost per million tokens / 每百万 token 成本。/ The real product metric: unaffordable capability is no capability.
Inference engine / 推理引擎。/ Squeezes the FLOPs dry: several times the throughput, zero weight changes.
GGUF / 单文件模型格式。/ A model packed into a box you can carry; suddenly a laptop is enough.
AWQ / 激活感知权重量化。/ Guess which weights don't matter — guess right and quantization is nearly free.
Embedding dimension / 嵌入维度。/ Address length per concept: too short to fit, too long and it's empty rooms.
Attention entropy / 注意力熵。/ High: still deciding where to look. Low: locked on.
Logit distribution / 对数几率分布。/ Every hesitation the model has before it speaks.
Vocabulary size / 词表大小。/ Granularity against memory: finer cuts save tokens, cost parameters.
